To provide accurate advice, it is necessary to know the growth stage of the cassava and the region where it is being grown, as these factors influence potential causes and treatments.

user_utterance: ਅਸੀਂ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਾਹੌਰ ਤੋਂ ਨੇੜੇ ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਹਾ ਕਿ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਦਬਾਅ ਲਈ ਟੈਬਲੇਟਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਕੀ ਅਸੀਂ ਨੇੜੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਾਂ?
english_reference_utterance: The clinic in our district near Kathmandu said they don’t have the tablets for blood pressure. Can we find them nearby?
cultural_context_note: ਪੁਨੇਬੀ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ 'ਲਾਹੌਰ' ਵਜੋਂ ਅਤੇ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਧਾਰਨ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ। ਦੁਕਾਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੁਵਿਧਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ।
reasoning_trace: The utterance seeks to check the availability of blood pressure medication near a district, so the function call should reflect this intent with the same medication name and location parameters.

user_utterance: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿਮਮਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਤਿੰਨ ਦਿਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਖਾਣ-ਪੀਣ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ ਹੈ। ਬੱਚੇ ਅਤੇ ਬੁੱਢੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਹਾਂਗੀ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ।
english_reference_utterance: My community in Jimma is out of water and food for the past three days. There are children and elderly people who need help.
cultural_context_note: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ 'ਜਿਮਮਾ' ਨੂੰ ਅਜੇਹਾ ਹੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਖੇਤਰ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਹੈ। ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਧਾਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ।
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a drought emergency in Jimma affecting children and elderly people, requiring water and food, so the report_emergency function is called with the appropriate arguments.

user_utterance: मेरे पिता को काठमांडू में अस्पताल ले जाने के लिए एम्बुलेंस की जरूरत है। उनको सांस लेने में तकलीफ है और उनके छाती में दर्द हो रहा है।
english_reference_utterance: I need an ambulance for my father in Kathmandu. He's having trouble breathing and chest pain.
cultural_context_note: भाषा ग्रामीण भारतीय अंदाज में बनाई गई है। जगह काठमांडू है, जो ग्रामीण भारत में विदित है। एम्बुलेंस के बारे में जानकारी ग्रामीण लोगों की बोली के अनुरूप है।
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a need for an ambulance in Kathmandu for a father with breathing difficulties and chest pain, matching the function call for requesting an ambulance with one patient and respiratory emergency.

user_utterance: ਮੈਨੂੰ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਤੇਜ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਰਸਤਾ ਸੁਧਾਰਨ ਦੀ ਜ਼ਰੂਰਤ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਮੁੰਡੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਹੈ। ਮੇਰੀ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਸੈਰ ਲਈ ਇਹ ਬੜਾ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਹੋ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਮੇਰਾ ਨੰਬਰ 9876543210 ਹੈ।
english_reference_utterance: The location is near the old school in Mekelle.
cultural_context_note: ਸਕੂਲ, ਰਸਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਨੰਬਰ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਦੇ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੁਕੂਲ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ। ਮੈਕੇਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਬਦਲ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ।

arguments.location_description: Near the old school in Mekelle

reasoning_trace: The user is reporting an urgent infrastructure issue with a road near an old school and provides their contact information for follow-up.
previous_context: Please provide the location of the road issue.

user_utterance: Ní paracetamol tẹyà ní ilé ẹjọ́rùn ìlú Ẹlẹ́gbẹ́dẹ́ ní ọdẹ 5 km?
english_reference_utterance: Can you check if paracetamol is available at the government hospital in Addis Ababa within 5 kilometers?
cultural_context_note: Iṣoro ẹjọ́rùn (hospital) tẹyà ní ìlú Ẹlẹ́gbẹ́dẹ́ tí wọn ń ríṣe ní ìlú Yoruba. Ọdẹ 5 km tẹyà ní ìlú Yoruba tí wọn ń ríṣe ní ìlú Ẹlẹ́gbẹ́dẹ́. Paracetamol tẹyà ní ìlú Yoruba.
reasoning_trace: The user is asking to check if paracetamol is available at a government hospital in Addis Ababa within 5 kilometers.

user_utterance: Gumaan biroo kan irratti Dhaka waliin gara gochaan irratti jiraan guddaa irratti kallattii dhabaatti irratti qopheessin.
english_reference_utterance: I want to book a routine appointment at the government hospital in Dhaka for a general checkup.
cultural_context_note: Dhaka Dhakaaf kallattii dhabaatti irratti qopheessin. Gochaan irratti jiraan guddaa irratti gumaan biroo kan irratti gara gochaan irratti jiraan guddaa irratti qopheessin.
reasoning_trace: The user wants to book a routine general checkup at a government hospital in Dhaka, so the function call for booking a clinic appointment with the given parameters is appropriate.

user_utterance: मोबाइल एप के मदद से अपनी बचत के अगले कटाई तक के ट्रैक कैसे करूं?
english_reference_utterance: Can you explain how to use a mobile app to track my savings for the next harvest?
cultural_context_note: भाषा और संदर्भ कृषि और ग्रामीण भारत (उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान) के अनुकूल बनाया गया है। बचत के ट्रैक करने के लिए मोबाइल एप के उपयोग का उल्लेख किया गया है, जो ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में आम है। बचत का उद्देश्य अगले फसल के लिए है, जो ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में प्रासंगिक है।
reasoning_trace: The utterance seeks guidance on using a mobile app to track savings for the next harvest, but no function call was provided in the original input.

user_utterance: किगली में सबसे पास के शरण स्थल तक का रास्ता भूस्खलन के कारण बंद हो गया है। क्या आप हमें कोई विकल्प बता सकते हैं या परिवहन व्यवस्था कर सकते हैं?
english_reference_utterance: The road to the nearest shelter in Kigali is blocked due to the landslide. Can you help us find an alternative or arrange transportation?
cultural_context_note: भाषा ग्रामीण भारत (उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान) के अनुकूल बनाई गई है। शब्द और रचना अधिकांश रूप से अनौपचारिक और ग्रामीण भाषा के अनुकूल है। स्थान के रूप में 'किगली' का उपयोग बनाए रखा गया है क्योंकि यह एक विदेशी शहर है और भारतीय संदर्भ में बदलने के लिए उपलब्ध संदर्भ नहीं है।
reasoning_trace: The utterance seeks to locate the nearest shelter from a blocked path in Kigali for 20 people, so the function 'locate_nearest_shelter' is called with the same location and people count.

user_utterance: Nataka kusijana kwenye hospital ya serikali katika wilaya ya Sylhet leo kwa ajili ya mama yangu kwa mshilo wa dharura.
english_reference_utterance: I need to book an emergency appointment for my mother at the government hospital in Sylhet today.
cultural_context_note: Pangilio na jina 'Sylhet' liliharibiki kwa kusikitisha wilaya ya East Africa kwa mfano, na kuchangia upekee wa hospital ya serikali ambayo inapatikana katika eneo hilo.
reasoning_trace: The utterance expresses a clear intent to book an emergency appointment at a government hospital in Sylhet today for a general condition, matching the function call.

user_utterance: मबांदका के आसपास के गांव में भयानक बरसात की कमी है। 200 लोग खाने और पानी के लिए परेशान हैं। कृपया मदद करें ताकि हालात और बिगड़े नहीं।
english_reference_utterance: The village near Mbandaka has been hit by a severe drought. 200 people need food and water. Please help us before the situation gets worse.
cultural_context_note: मुद्रा और सेवा के नाम बदले नहीं गए क्योंकि वे वैश्विक नाम हैं, लेकिन भाषा का रूप ग्रामीण और अनौपचारिक हिंदी में बनाया गया है। बरसात की कमी के लिए स्थानीय शब्दों का उपयोग किया गया है।
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a drought emergency in a village near Mbandaka affecting 200 people with urgent need for food and water, prompting the report_emergency function call.

user_utterance: මම පුත්‍රිය ඇයිෂාව රියදුරු කරන්න අවශ්‍ය ය. ඇය මැයි 21 වන දින චිත්තගාංගේ උපත් වූවා ය. ඇයිෂාගේ දාදා මිනිසුරුවාගේ හැඳුනුම්පත් අංකය BD123456 ය.
english_reference_utterance: I need to register my daughter, Ayesha, who was born in Chittagong on 21st of May. Her mother's ID is BD123456.
cultural_context_note: සිංහල භාෂාව භාවිතා කර ලද අතර, පුත්‍රියාගේ නම ඇයිෂා නම් ලෙස තබා ගනු ලැබීය. උපත් දිනය සහ ස්ථානය සඳහා මැයි 21 සහ චිත්තගාං යන අභිබාවය භාවිතා කරන ලදී. දාදා මිනිසුරුවාගේ හැඳුනුම්පත් අංකය පෙරවරුවට සමාන ලෙස තබා ගනු ලැබීය.
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests to register a child's birth with the child's name, birth date, birth location, and mother's ID provided, which directly maps to the 'register_birth' function.

user_utterance: 50 ሰው ከማይዒዚግሪ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ እስከ የተጠናቀቀ አካባቢ እስከ ሌላ ማስተላለፍ ያስፈልጋል ምክንያቱም የውጭ ማዕቀፍ አለ። እነዚህ ከዚህ በፊት አንዳንድ አልተጠናቀቀው ናቸው።
english_reference_utterance: We need to evacuate 50 people from Maiduguri, Nigeria because of the conflict. Some are injured.
cultural_context_note: The utterance was adapted to use Amharic script and natural colloquial language. The location was kept as Maiduguri, Nigeria, as it is a real place, and the context of conflict and evacuation is universally applicable.
reasoning_trace: The user is requesting an immediate evacuation of 50 people, including 10 mobility-impaired individuals, from Maiduguri, Nigeria, due to a conflict.

user_utterance: Tuma kallatti addunyaa dagaaree wajjiin wal qabsa kutaa Addis Ababa keessatti. Kallatti barree 3 ta'ee dura.
english_reference_utterance: The accident happened near the health centre in Kathmandu. Three people were injured.
cultural_context_note: Kallatti Kathmandu Addis Ababaa irratti qophaame, kutaa wajjiin wal qabsa kutaa Addis Ababa keessatti qophaame. Kallatti barree 3 ta'ee dura.

arguments.location_description: near the health centre in Addis Ababa

reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a trauma emergency with three injured people near a health center, which aligns with the request_ambulance function.
previous_context: Can you share the exact location and how many people were injured?

user_utterance: Mo ní ẹ̀wé láti kòsi aráyé málàràrín ní ìlú Ẹ̀wẹ̀tẹ̀wà ní Ìbàdílẹ̀ Iṣẹ̀wé Ìjẹ̀wéwà ní Ibadan
english_reference_utterance: I need to check if malaria medicine is available in the local clinic in Kathmandu.
cultural_context_note: Kathmandu wàsíṣẹ̀pọ̀ rírì ìjẹ̀wéwà láti Ibadan, ìgbàrúlẹ̀ ìjẹ̀wéwà tí wọn ní ní ìlú Yoruba. Àwọn ẹ̀wé málàràrín tí wọn tún ní ní ìlú Yoruba wà ń sọ pé aráyé málàràrín (artemether-lumefantrine) wà ní ìgbàlẹ̀rẹ̀.
reasoning_trace: The user is asking to check the availability of malaria medication at a local clinic within a 5 km radius in Kathmandu, which is a direct translation of the original function call.

user_utterance: ኩባ ከጅوبا በቅርብ እየደረሰነ በሰው ምክንያት ማሽከርከር እየደረሰነ ነው። የ40 ፈሚላ የተጠቀሰ ቦታ እና 5 የምታወቁ ሴቶች ማግኘት አለባለን።
english_reference_utterance: My village near Juba has been displaced due to conflict. We need to find the nearest shelter for 40 families, including 5 pregnant women.
cultural_context_note: Used local Tigrinya phrasing and Ethiopic script. Retained the function intent of finding shelter for displaced people with special needs. The location 'Juba' is retained as it is a known reference point, and the number of people and special needs are adapted to fit the local context.
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a displacement situation near Juba with 40 families and 5 pregnant women, requiring the locate_nearest_shelter function to be called with the same parameters.

user_utterance: मेरे बेटे को दो दिन से बुखार है। मुझे जांच करने की जरूरत है कि पैरासिटामोल फिलहाल फनोम पेन में किसी भी नजदीकी स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में उपलब्ध है या नहीं।
english_reference_utterance: I need to check if paracetamol is available in any clinic near Phnom Penh for my son's fever. It's been two days since he started having it.
cultural_context_note: भाषा ग्रामीण भारत (उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान) के लिए स्थानीय और अनौपचारिक रजिस्टर में है। स्वास्थ्य देखभाल के लिए स्वास्थ्य केंद्र (PHC) का उल्लेख किया गया है। शहर का नाम फनोम पेन अपरिवर्तित रहा है।
reasoning_trace: The user is seeking to find out if paracetamol is available in any nearby clinic in Phnom Penh to treat their son's fever, which has persisted for two days.

user_utterance: កុមាររបស់ខ្ញុំមានអាយុ 14 ខែ ហើយមិនបានទទួលវ៉ាក់ស៊ីនចុងក្រោយនៅ Sylhet នេះ ខ្ញុំត្រូវធ្វើអ្វីខ្លះ?
english_reference_utterance: My child is 14 months old and missed the last vaccination in Sylhet. What do I need to do?
cultural_context_note: ទីក្រុង Sylhet មិនមាននៅក្នុងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា ប៉ុន្តែត្រូវបានរក្សាទុកដើម្បីរក្សាភាពត្រឹមត្រូវនៃព័ត៌មានទីកន្លែង។ គ្មានការផ្លាស់ប្ដូរផ្នែកវប្បធម៌ផ្សេងទៀតដែលមានសារសំខាន់។
reasoning_trace: The utterance seeks information on the vaccination schedule for a 14-month-old child in Sylhet, prompting a call to the get_vaccination_schedule function with the relevant arguments.

user_utterance: ຂ້ອຍຄວນຈະປ່ອມດິນໃຫ້ຕົ້ນຄາຟີໃນເຂດເມືອງໄມ້ເປັງໃນສາມອາທິດຕໍ່ໄປເວລາໃດດີ?

cultural_context_note: ຄຳວ່າ 'Mwea' ແມ່ນຖືກຮັກສາໄວ້ເນື່ອງຈາກເປັນຊື່ຂອງເມືອງໃນເຄັນຢາ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຄວາມຄິດຄ້າຍໃນພາສາລາວ. ຕົວຢ່າງນີ້ຖືກປະດິດຂື້ນໃນລາວ ແຕ່ເນື່ອງຈາກເປັນຕົວຢ່າງການປຸງແຕ່ງຂໍ້ມູນ ສະນັ້ນຈຶ່ງຮັກສາຊື່ເມືອງໄມ້ເປັງເປັນຕົ້ນສະບັບ. ອື່ນໆເຊັ່ນ 'ກາຟີ' ແມ່ນຖືກໃຊ້ໃນຄວາມໝາຍທົ່ວໄປ ແລະ 'ສາມອາທິດຕໍ່ໄປ' ແມ່ນຖືກປ່ຽນໃຫ້ເຂົ້າກັບພາສາລາວ.
reasoning_trace: The utterance asks for advice on when to fertilize coffee plants near Mwea in the next three weeks, which maps directly to the get_weather_planting_advice function with the same arguments.

user_utterance: मेरी बेटी के लिए दिल्ली में एक क्लिनिक की बुकिंग कर सकते हो?

cultural_context_note: Dhaka को दिल्ली में बदल दिया गया है जो उत्तर प्रदेश और देश के अन्य हिस्सों के लोगों के लिए अधिक परिचित है। स्थानीय स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं के संदर्भ में जनस्वास्थ्य केंद्र (PHC) का उल्लेख करना अधिक सामान्य होगा, लेकिन यहाँ भाषा और संदर्भ ग्रामीण और अनौपचारिक है।

arguments.what_to_ask: What type of facility are you looking to book, and how urgent is the appointment?

reasoning_trace: The utterance requests a clinic appointment for a daughter, but lacks details on the type of facility and urgency, so the system should ask for clarification on these missing fields.

user_utterance: យើងបានស្តាយពីអ្នកផ្សព្វផ្សាយសុខភាពថាម្ហឹងក្តៅមិនមាននៅសណ្ឋាគារសុខភាពរបស់យើងទេ។ តើមានវិធីណាមួយដែលអាចរកវាបាននៅជិតទេ?
english_reference_utterance: We heard from the CHW that the medicine for fever isn't available in our health post. Is there a way to find it nearby?

reasoning_trace: The user is asking if there is a nearby facility within 15 km in the district of Kano where Paracetamol is available, based on information from a community health worker.

user_utterance: ਫ਼ਿਊਮ ਪੇਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਹਤ ਕੇਂਦਰ 'ਤੇ ਇੰਸੁਲਿਨ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈ ਕੀ?

cultural_context_note: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਅਸਲੀ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਵਰਗੇ ਲੱਗਣ ਲਈ 'ਫ਼ਿਊਮ ਪੇਨ' ਰੱਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ। ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਦਵਾਈ ਦੀ ਉਪਲਬਧਤਾ ਬਾਰੇ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸੰਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਹਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਆਮ ਚੀਜ਼ ਹੈ।
reasoning_trace: User is asking if insulin is available at a health center in Phnom Penh, which requires checking medication availability.

user_utterance: මගේ පුත්‍රයා නායා නිවසේ නමුත් මේ සඳහා රජයේ නම් දැක්වීම වැළඳීම කරන්න පුළුවන්ද?
english_reference_utterance: My son was born at home, but I need to register him. Is that possible?
cultural_context_note: ස්වාභාවික සිංහල භාෂාවෙන් පවත්වාගිය අතර, නිවසේ පුත්‍රයා නම් දැක්වීම සඳහා අවශ්‍ය යැයි අදහස් පවත්වාගියේ ස්වාභාවික ආකාරයෙනි. නිවසේ පුත්‍රයා නම් දැක්වීම සඳහා රජයේ නියම් වෙනත් වෙන්ව නොමැති බවට අදාල ය. මෙය සිංහල භාෂාවෙන් පවත්වාගිය අතර, නිවසේ පුත්‍රයා නම් දැක්වීම සඳහා අවශ්‍ය යැයි අදහස් පවත්වාගියේ ස්වාභාවික ආකාරයෙනි.

arguments.what_to_ask: ඔව්, ඔබේ පුත්‍රයා නායා නිවසේ නම් දැක්වීම සඳහා පුළුවන් ය. ඔහුගේ නම් සහ උපන් දිනය කරුණාකර දෙන්න පුළුවන් ද?

reasoning_trace: The user is asking if it is possible to register their son who was born at home. The function call is asking for clarification by requesting the child's name and birth date, which are required for the registration process.

user_utterance: 100 ਡਾਲਰ ਨੂੰ ਕੈਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਬਦਲਦਾ ਹੈ?

reasoning_trace: The user is asking for the exchange rate from USD to KES for an amount of 100, which matches the function call for get_exchange_rate with the same parameters.

user_utterance: මෙම මිනිස්සුන් මෙහි පාවුරු මිල අවම කරන්න දැක්වෙනවා ද? අපේ කොෆී මෙහි සහය බැඳි වෙන්න දැක්වෙනවා ද?
english_reference_utterance: I need the price of groundnuts at Mercato Addis and to register my coffee harvest for cooperative sale.
cultural_context_note: මෙම ප්‍රකාශය ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කෘෂිකර්මය ප්‍රසංගයට අද්‍රෝහිත කරන ලදි. පාවුරු සහ කොෆී සාමාන්‍ය ශ්‍රී ලංකා භාණ්ඩයක් බවට පත්විය. මෙහි යළි නැවත ලැබෙන සහය බැඳි සඳහා ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ සාමාන්‍ය කෘෂිකර්මා ප්‍රකාශයක් භාවිතා කරන ලදි.
reasoning_trace: The user is requesting the market price of groundnuts at a specific location and registering their coffee harvest for a cooperative sale, which matches the function calls for get_market_price and register_cooperative_sale.

user_utterance: យើងត្រូវ​បាន​បញ្ជូន​បុគ្គល ៧០ នាក់​ចេញ​ពី​កន្លែង​ដែល​នៅ​ជិត​ទន្លេ​ប៉ូ​បើ​ទឹក​បាន​ហួស​ពី​ទន្លេ​ហើយ។ វា​ជា​រឿង​សំខាន់​ណាស់។

cultural_context_note: បាន​ប្ដូរ​ទីតាំង​ពី​ Lome ទៅ​ជា​ទន្លេ​ដែល​ជា​ទីតាំង​សំខាន់​នៅ​ក្នុង​ប្រទេស​កម្ពុជា។ បាន​ប្ដូរ​ពាក្យ​និយាយ​ទៅ​ជា​ភាសា​ធម្មតា​ដែល​អ្នក​និយាយ​ភាសា​ខ្មែរ​ពិត​ប្រាកដ​នឹង​ប្រើ។
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests an immediate evacuation of 70 people from a location near Lome due to flooding, matching the function call for 'request_evacuation'.

reasoning_trace: The utterance expresses a need to register a child's birth with personal and parental ID details, which maps directly to the 'register_birth' function.

user_utterance: උදේ කඩු ගැලවී තිබේ නම් අපේ කෝෆී අදාල් කාලයේ බිමට යා යුතුද?
english_reference_utterance: The moon has been smiling at the fields in Jimma. Is this a sign to plant our coffee now?
cultural_context_note: මෙම වාක්‍යය සිංහල කර්මාන්තයේ අනුව ප්‍රකාශ කර තිබේ. පාරිසරික සන්දර්ශන අනුව කෝෆී බිමට යාම සම්බන්ධව සැක අදහසක් ඇති කරන ලදි. භාෂාව කතා රැසක් ලෙස නිර්මාණය කරන ලදි.
reasoning_trace: The user is asking for advice on whether to plant coffee now based on the moon's appearance, which implies a need for weather-based planting guidance.

user_utterance: මගේ කැස්සාව ජෝස් නළුවේ හොඳින් පැවතිනොමී. මූලික වර්ධනය නොවන අතර ගිල්ලු පාට යෙල්ලෝ වේ.
english_reference_utterance: My cassava is not growing well in Jos. The roots are not developing and the leaves are yellow.
cultural_context_note: ජෝස් නළුව සිංහල භාෂාකරණය කරන ලදි. නිවර්තන නිර්මාණය සඳහා භාවිතා කරන සිංහල භාෂාවේ ක්‍රමය ප්‍රකාශ කරන ලදි. සිංහල භාෂාවේ ප්‍රකෘතිය භාවිතා කරන ලදි.
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes symptoms of a cassava plant in the vegetative stage, specifically poor root development and yellow leaves, prompting a request for disease diagnosis.

user_utterance: Muna kauka kwaruwa daga 3 maitace da Addis Ababa. Wadda 80 wane da kwaruwa duniya, kamar 10 kuje da 3 wace watsar. Muna kauka kwaruwa kafin kafin.
english_reference_utterance: We have not received food in 3 days in Addis Ababa. There are 80 people in our community, including 10 children and 3 elderly. We need food distribution immediately.
cultural_context_note: Muna amana lokaci na Addis Ababa kuma kauka kwaruwa, wani lokaci da kafin kafin. Kamar da kuje da wace watsar, kamar da duniya, ya kauka kwaruwa. Kafin kafin ya amana da kafin kafin.
reasoning_trace: The user is requesting food distribution for their community in Addis Ababa, specifying the number of beneficiaries, the number of days without food, and vulnerable groups, which triggers the 'request_food_distribution' function.

user_utterance: අපි මිනිසුන් 7 දෙනෙක් මීඕ හැමි වෙලෙවියේ නැරඹුණු අතර පුපුෂා සඳහා අවකාශයක් ඇති පාසැල්ලක් සොයා ගැනීමට අවශ්‍ය ය.
english_reference_utterance: We have 7 people from Mwea near a shelter and need to know the nearest one with space for infants.
cultural_context_note: මීඕ යනු ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ප්‍රසිද්ධ නගරයකි. පාසැල්ලා යනු භාවිතා කරන ලද වචනය වන අතර, පුපුෂා සඳහා අවකාශයක් ඇති පාසැල්ලක් සොයා ගැනීම අවශ්‍ය ය යන්න ප්‍රකාශ කරයි.
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests to locate a shelter near Mwea that can accommodate 7 people including infants.

user_utterance: ਮੈਂ 1234567890 ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿਚ 1000 ਰੁਪਏ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਬਿੱਲ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ।
english_reference_utterance: I need to pay 1000 ETB for electricity to account number 1234567890.
cultural_context_note: ਬੋਲੀ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (ਭਾਰਤ) ਦੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਿਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ। ਰਸਮੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਦੀ ਬਜਾਇ ਸਾਦੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਜਿਕ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ। ਕਰੰਸੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੁਪਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ। ਸੇਵਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਪਾਦਿਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ।
reasoning_trace: ਉਪਭੋਗੀ ਇਕ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਬਿੱਲ ਦੀ ਰਸਮੀ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਇਕ ਖਾਤੇ ਨੰਬਰ ਦੇ ਜ਼ਰੀਏ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।

user_utterance: ខ្ញុំទើបតែឃើញមានជំនាញលិចនៅក្រុងភ្នំពេញ ជាពិសេសតំបន់ស្រីយ៉ាមូលី មានអ្នករងគ្រោះប្រហែល 200 នាក់ ពួកគេត្រូវការអាហារ ទឹក និងកន្លែងផ្ទះ

cultural_context_note: បានប្ដូរទីតាំងទៅជា ‘ភ្នំពេញ’ ដែលជាទីក្រុងធំនៅកម្ពុជា និងតំបន់ ‘ស្រីយ៉ាមូលី’ ដែលជាតំបន់ស្រុកមួយ។ បានប្ដូរការបញ្ជាក់អ្នករងគ្រោះទៅជា ‘200 នាក់’ ដែលសមស្របនឹងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a flood in a specific location with a number of affected people and their immediate needs, which maps directly to the 'report_emergency' function with the provided arguments.

user_utterance: ਮੈਂ ਜਾਣਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਚੌਲੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਦੋਂ ਖਾਦ ਦੇਣੀ ਹੈ।

reasoning_trace: The utterance indicates a food emergency near Harare, with 180 people without food for 3 days, so the 'request_food_distribution' function is called with these parameters.

english_reference_utterance: I want to book an emergency appointment at the government hospital in Lagos today for my son who has a high fever.
cultural_context_note: රෝහල් නම සහ ප්‍රදේශය සිංහල භාෂා පරිසරයට අනුකූල කරන ලදී. පුත්‍රයා නිර්දේශය මාවත් නිර්දේශය ලෙස අනුකූල කරන ලදී.

user_utterance: මොම්බසා න්‍යාසයේ වෙළෙද මා 200 කි.ග්‍රා. සෝර්ග්‍රැම් සඳහා නිතරම ඇති ය.

cultural_context_note: කාර්මික අරමුණ්‍රේ සඳහා ඉංග්‍රීසි වචනය භාවිතා කරන ලදී (සෝර්ග්‍රැම්). ප්‍රමාණය ද පාවිච්චි කරන ලදී (200 කි.ග්‍රා.). න්‍යාස නම පාවිච්චි කරන ලදී (මොම්බසා න්‍යාසය).
reasoning_trace: The user is asking about the best market for selling 200kg of sorghum, which implies they want to check the market price in Mombasa.
previous_context: Where do you plan to sell your sorghum?

user_utterance: ਮੈਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੀ ਬਿਲ ਦਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
english_reference_utterance: I want to pay my water bill.
cultural_context_note: ਪਾਣੀ ਦੀ ਬਿਲ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲਤਾ ਬਣਾਈ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਭਾਰਤੀ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਿਪੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।

arguments.what_to_ask: ਜੀ, ਮੈਂ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਪਾਣੀ ਦੀ ਬਿਲ ਲਈ ਖਾਤਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ?

reasoning_trace: The user wants to pay their water bill, so the system asks for the account number and the amount to proceed with the payment.

user_utterance: ມື້ນີ້ມີຄົນປ່ວຍດ້ວຍການຫັນຫຼາຍຂຶ້ນໃນບ້ານຂອງເຮົາໃນເມືອງຊີລເຮດ. ພວກເຮົາຢ້ານວ່າມັນເປັນພະຍາດໄຂ້ຫຼາຍ ແລະ ມື້ນີ້ມັນໄດ້ປ່ວຍເດັກນ້ອຍ 15 ຄົນແລ້ວ.

reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a sudden rise in cough cases in a village, with concern about measles and 15 children affected, which matches the function call for reporting a disease outbreak.

user_utterance: Nataka kuwapongeza maziwa yangu kupitia jeshi. Je, ni kiasi gani unaweza kupata?

arguments.what_to_ask: Sure, I can help with that. How much cotton do you want to sell, and what quality grade does it have?

arguments.what_to_ask: මම ආහාර පරිපාලනය සම්බන්ධයෙන් ඔබට උපකාර කරන හැකිය. මෙය පිළිබඳව ඔබ දැන ගැනීමට අවශ්‍ය යැයි සිතන්නේ ආහාර මාර්ගය තුළ ආයෙදුම් දෙන විට සහ ඔබ කුමන දිශාවක ඇතිනේ යන්න පිළිබඳව දැන ගැනීම සඳහායි?

reasoning_trace: The function call is appropriate because the user's utterance indicates a need for vaccination information and requires clarification on the vaccines already received and the user's location to provide accurate guidance.

user_utterance: මාගේ ඇල්ලුම් ගොඩ තොගට පාර්ශව නිරීක්ෂක එකක් මෙතැන පෙනී සිටීමට අවශ්‍ය අතර මේ සතියේ එකක් ලබා ගත නොහැකිද?
english_reference_utterance: I need an extension officer to check my yam farm in Jos. Is there one available this week?
cultural_context_note: කාර්මික අරමුදල් නම් සහ ස්ථාන නිර්දේශයන් සිංහල ව්‍යාපාර සංස්කෘතියට අනුව ප්‍රකාශ කරන ලදී. ප්‍රකාශනය ලඟා පෙළ සඳහා භාවිතා කරන ලද සිංහල කථා භාෂාවේ ආකාරය භාවිතා කරන ලදී.
reasoning_trace: The user is requesting an extension officer to inspect their yam farm in Jos and wants to know if one is available this week.

user_utterance: N'okpuru akwụkwọ na Lagos n'ime, na ọ dị mma NGID-987654321 dị mma. Akụkọ m na-ahụ dị anụ?
english_reference_utterance: I applied for a national ID in Lagos last week, and the reference number was NGID-987654321. Could you tell me the status?
cultural_context_note: Lagos bụ ụlọ ọhịa dị mma na Igbo. Ụdị akwụkwọ dị mma na ọhịa ị nwere ike ịgbakwunye. N'okpuru akwụkwọ bụ ụdị ọhịa dị mma na ọhịa ị nwere ike ịgbakwunye na ụlọ ọhịa dị mma.
reasoning_trace: The utterance asks about the status of a national ID application with a specific reference number, which matches the 'check_document_status' function.

user_utterance: Tunapata 7 watu kutoka Mwea karibu na nyumba ya usalama na lazima tujue iliyopo karibu sana na uwezo wa kusimamia watoto.
english_reference_utterance: We have 7 people from Mwea near a shelter and need to know the nearest one with space for infants.
cultural_context_note: Mwea ni jina la enzi la Kenya ambalo linalosimamia mazao ya maziwa na matokeo. Tumekuwa na enzi za usalama ambazo zinaweza kuwa karibu na enzi hizo kwa ajili ya watumia.
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests to locate a nearby shelter in Mwea that can accommodate 7 people, including infants, which matches the function 'locate_nearest_shelter' with the provided arguments.

user_utterance: Nnọpụ 5000 n’okpom Ọpẹyị na akpụrụ ọha OPay dị m na 01712345678.
english_reference_utterance: Send 5000 BDT to my brother’s bKash account using the number 01712345678.
cultural_context_note: Nnọpụ 5000 BDT na-egwuregwu na 5000 n’okpom Ọpẹyị. OPay bụ onye ọrụ ọha dị mma na Anambra. Ọha OPay bụ ọha mobile money dị mma na ụlọ ọha dị mma na Ụlọ Ọha Ọpẹyị na Ịgbo.
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests sending a specific amount of money to a specific mobile money account using a specific service provider, which aligns with the 'send_mobile_money' function.

user_utterance: እርዳለሁ ህርሻ በግብርና የተባበሩ ምንባባት አለኝ።
english_reference_utterance: I need help with my crops. There's a problem with the soil.
cultural_context_note: The crops and soil issues are common in the Tigray and Eritrean regions. The reference to extension workers is adapted to local agricultural support systems.

arguments.what_to_ask: Sure, I can help with that. Could you tell me your location and a preferred date when you'd like the extension worker to visit?

reasoning_trace: The user is seeking agricultural assistance, and the system needs to gather location and timing details to schedule a visit from a local extension worker.

user_utterance: N'ime ike n'aka m ka ozi m na Jimma. E nwere ike ị dị m na Kawran Bazar n'oyibo?
english_reference_utterance: I want to sell my coffee from Jimma. Can you tell me the price at Kawran Bazar today?
cultural_context_note: Nworie na Jimma dị mma n'ime Igbo, na Kawran Bazar dị mma dị mma n'aka m. Nwere ike ị nwe ozi m na 100kg dị mma n'aka m n'ime Igbo.
reasoning_trace: The user is asking for the current market price of coffee at Kawran Bazar, which triggers the get_market_price function with the specified arguments.

user_utterance: ਮੇਰੀ ਕੱਢੀ ਨਸੂਕ੍ਕਾ ਵਿਚ ਚੰਗੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਵਧ ਰਹੀ। ਸ਼ਾਖਾਵਾਂ ਮਜਬੂਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਪੱਤੀਆਂ ਟੁੱਕੜੇ-ਟੁੱਕੜੇ ਹਨ।
english_reference_utterance: My yam is not growing well in Nsukka. The stems are weak and the leaves are patchy.
cultural_context_note: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੱਢੀ ਦੀ ਪੈਦਾਵਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ, ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ੰਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਨਸੂਕ੍ਕਾ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes symptoms of a yam plant in the vegetative stage, and the function call seeks a diagnosis for the crop disease in the specified region.

user_utterance: ខ្ញុំត្រូវការអាកាស្សាន្តសម្រាប់ម្ដាយខ្ញុំនៅភ្នំពេញ។ នាងមានបញ្ហាក្នុងការដកដង្ហើម។
english_reference_utterance: I need an ambulance for my mother in Phnom Penh. She has trouble breathing.
cultural_context_note: នៅភ្នំពេញគឺជាកន្លែងដែលមានសេវាសុខភាព និងអាកាស្សាន្ត។ បញ្ហាក្នុងការដកដង្ហើមគឺជាកាយវិការស្មុគស្មាញដែលត្រូវការការពិនិត្យ។

arguments.what_to_ask: បាទ/ស្រី។ អ្នកអាចពិពណ៌នាលំអិតអំពីទីតាំងដែលម្ដាយអ្នកស្ថិតនៅ និងចំនួនអ្នកជំងឺដែលត្រូវដឹកជញ្ជូនបានទេ?

reasoning_trace: The user is requesting an ambulance for their mother in Phnom Penh, mentioning difficulty in breathing. The function call asks for clarification on the exact location and number of patients to be transported, which are critical for dispatching emergency services.

user_utterance: ກວດເບິ່ງວ່າ metformin ມີຢູ່ບໍ່ໃນສະຖານັດສາເຫຼວຢູ່ເມືອງວຽງຄັນ ໃນຂອບເຂດ 3 ກິໂລແມັດ
english_reference_utterance: Check if metformin is available at the health centres in Kathmandu within 3 km.
cultural_context_note: ປ່ຽນ 'Kathmandu' ເປັນ 'ວຽງຄັນ' ເຊິ່ງເປັນເມືອງໃນລາວ ແລະ ສະຖານັດສາເຫຼວ ເປັນຄໍາທີ່ໃຊ້ໃນລາວ ເພື່ອໃຫ້ເຂົ້າກັບການດັດແປງທາງວັດທະນະທັມ ແລະ ປະເພດຂໍ້ມູນດ້ານສາເຫຼວ
reasoning_trace: The utterance asks to check the availability of metformin at health facilities in Kathmandu within a 3 km radius, which maps directly to the check_medication_availability function with the provided arguments.

user_utterance: እኔ በወቃቑ የወላጆች ድም ተፈልጉ ነበር።
english_reference_utterance: I want to check my Wave wallet balance.
cultural_context_note: Wave የሞባይል ፍላጎት አገልግሎት እንደሚባል በትግራኛ አገልግሎት ላይ የሚያገናኝ ስም ነው። የሞባይል ፍላጎት በትግራኛ እና አማርኛ ምክንያት በጣም የሚያገኝ ነው፣ ስለዚህ የሞባይል ድም ማረጋገጫ የሚያስፈልግ የትግራኛ ተጠቃሚ ሁሉ እንዲረዳ ነው ተዘጋጅቶ።
reasoning_trace: The user wants to check their Wave wallet balance, so the 'check_balance' function is called with the service provider 'wave' and account type 'wallet'.

user_utterance: የጋምበላ እኛ እግዚአብሔር እንደ 5 ቀናት በፊት እልማት የለም፣ እና እኛ 150 ሰው ይጠይቀዋል፣ ይህም የ40 ሰው እድሜ ያላት ሰው ይካተታል።
english_reference_utterance: Our community near Gambela has been without food for 5 days, and we need support for 150 people, including 40 elderly individuals.
cultural_context_note: The utterance uses the local place name 'Gambela' and references the vulnerable group 'elderly' as per the original. The numbers and function call remain consistent with the original request.
reasoning_trace: The utterance requests food distribution for 150 people in Gambela who have been without food for 5 days, including 40 elderly individuals.

user_utterance: Wadda wane da wuya kuma, kafin koyi koyi, kamar da ya koyi. Ya kamar da ya koyi?
english_reference_utterance: My son was born at home, but I need to register him. Is that possible?
cultural_context_note: The phrase 'born at home' is adapted to 'wuya kuma' (born at home) which is a natural Hausa expression. The context of registration is kept general and relevant to government services in Northern Nigeria.

arguments.what_to_ask: Yes, it's possible to register your son even if he was born at home. Could you please provide his name and date of birth?

reasoning_trace: The user is asking if it is possible to register their son who was born at home, which requires clarification on the child's name and birth date to proceed with the registration.

user_utterance: ਮੈਨੂੰ 300 ਕਿਲੋ ਜਵੋं ਵੇਚਣ ਹਨ। ਮੈਂ ਮੈਕੇਲੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਹਿਯੋਗੀ ਵੇਚਣ ਲਈ ਰਜਿਸਟਰ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
english_reference_utterance: I have 300 kg of millet to sell. I want to register for the cooperative sale in Mekelle.
cultural_context_note: ਜਵੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਫਸਲ ਹੈ। ਸਹਿਯੋਗੀ ਵੇਚਣ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਮੈਕੇਲੇ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
reasoning_trace: The utterance expresses intent to register for a cooperative sale of millet, which aligns with the function call for 'register_cooperative_sale' with the provided arguments.

user_utterance: මාගේ ජව සත්වය බිල් ප්‍රමාණයේ පැයිස් අතර ගිනි රෝගයක් ඇති විය හැකියාව පවතී.
english_reference_utterance: My millet is in the flowering stage and has been infected by a fungal disease.
cultural_context_note: ඉංග්‍රීසි භාෂාවෙන් සිංහල බාෂාවට පරිවර්තනය කරන විට, නියුක්තිය සිංහල කෘත්‍යයට අනුව සාමාන්‍ය පරිසරයට අදාළ අවස්ථාවක් බවට පත් කරන ලදී. ප්‍රදේශය නිර්ණය කිරීම සඳහා බෝපල් භාවිතා කරන ලදී, ප්‍රකෘතිය අනුව ජව සත්වය භාවිතා කරන ලදී සහ ගිනි රෝගය භාවිතා කරන ලදී.
reasoning_trace: The utterance describes a millet crop in the flowering stage that is infected with a fungal disease, prompting the need for a crop disease diagnosis.
previous_context: What is the problem with your millet?

user_utterance: मौसम के अपने तीन दिन बाद बरसात होगी। मैं चावल की बुवाई करना चाहता हूँ।
english_reference_utterance: The weather forecast says rain in the next three days. I want to plant rice.
cultural_context_note: भाषा ग्रामीण भारत (उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान) के अनुकूल बनाई गई है। फसल के रूप में चावल और गतिविधि के रूप में बुवाई लोकप्रिय है। स्थान के रूप में भक्तपुर का उपयोग किया गया है, जो भारत में एक वास्तविक स्थान है।
reasoning_trace: The user is seeking advice on whether to plant rice in the next three days despite the rain forecast.
previous_context: Do you need planting advice for your rice?
